description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this token. It must be unique across requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
是否是故障切换后的回切至原主可用区，取值范围如下：

- true：是。
- false：不是。
description.en:
Specifies whether to fail back to the original primary zone after a failover. Valid values:

- true: Yes.

- false: No.

description.zh: 将要切换为主节点的节点 ID，如果不填，则系统自动选举。您可以通过接口 DescribeDBClusters 查询节点 ID 等信息。
description.en: The ID of the node to promote to the primary node. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically selects a node. Call the DescribeDBClusters operation to query node information, such as node IDs.

description.zh:
是否是主可用区内主备切换，取值如下：

- Primary：主可用区内主备切换。
- Standby：切换至存储热备集群。
description.en:
The type of failover. Valid values:

- Primary: A primary/secondary failover within the primary zone.

- Standby: A switch to the hot standby storage cluster.

title.zh: 对边缘集群进行手动主备切换

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb failover-db-cluster-zonal --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --target-db-node-id pi-00000000000 --roll-back-for-disaster false --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f54a343f1a4233c1e7d1c5000000 --target-zone-type Primary --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb FailoverDBClusterZonal --region cn-hangzhou --RollBackForDisaster false --TargetZoneType Primary --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000' --TargetDBNodeId 'pi-00000000000' --ClientToken 6000170000591aed949d0f54a343f1a4233c1e7d1c5000000
